sentences.en: I feel a strong attraction to the music of Beethoven.
sentences.zh: 我被贝多芬的音乐深深吸引。

sentences.en: His chief attraction lies in his character, not his looks.
sentences.zh: 他最大的吸引力在于他的性格，而不是外貌。

sentences.en: From time to time she felt an attraction to poetry.
sentences.zh: 她不时会被诗歌所吸引。

senses.zh: 吸引力，魅力；吸引人的事物，有吸引力的人或物；景点，游览胜地
